notes: 24 first-round concerns scored (excluded C4, C8, C14, C20, C21, C22, C24, C28, C31 by category). Referees reviewed a manuscript matching arXiv v1, and none of the scored fixes (singlet simulations, Au fits, field data under pressure, kBT/Delta=0.1 simulations, Table S1 labels) appear in the v1 text, so fixed_in_v1 is false throughout. A raised 4 and partly 3; B raised 16 and partly 6. A is a narrow lookalike/control check that matches the contact-regime, reproducibility and Ic concerns but misses the theory and model-comparison concerns. B's model-related matches on C12 and C29 are neighbouring rather than exact; B's C7 match identifies the B2u/B3u ambiguity but does not ask for a measurement on another facet. A's normalization/series-resistance and Kondo-ZBA points were judged distinct from C6 (Fano background) and listed as extras.
